changelog:
- Initial release of the "best-minds" skill.
- Provides expert-level answers by simulating the world's top minds in relevant fields.
- Focuses on sourcing responses from the most knowledgeable individuals, using their real statements or publications when possible.
- Encourages basing simulations on authentic, publicly available thoughts rather than generic or preset personas.
- Differentiates itself from other skills by prioritizing genuine expertise and avoiding AI's own opinions.
